title: Riddle: write on your reMarkable, watch the AI reply animate back stroke by stroke
description:
Riddle turns a reMarkable tablet into Tom Riddle's enchanted diary: you write with the pen, the page drinks your ink, and a reply writes itself back in flowing script. Chatting with an AI on an e-ink device usually means a laggy keyboard and a chat bubble UI that kills the whole feel. This reads your raw handwriting straight off the pen, sends the committed page to a resident on-device model, and animates the answer stroke by stroke.

https://github.com/MaximeRivest/riddle
